reviews.review:
I'm very on the fence about this game, because it is such a fun game. The parkour is fluid and fast, the combat is quick and satisfying, but there are a number of things lacking here. This game was released back in 2013 but it still feels like this game isn't finished. There are so many grey areas with the story, which is still unfinished. The addition of Nightwave is just to give the player more side missions, and none of the characters you meet are super memorable. This game is massive, and sprawling, and in my opinion, there's just too much stuff here. There are like 3 open world planets all of which have their own side missions, bounty levels, money systems, night and day cycles, and that's not even including all the other planets in the solar system which each have their own series of levels that you can complete. However, nothing really pushes you to play through all these levels. Unless you need to unlock a node, you can skip the majority of the levels on a planet and play through the story just fine. And I will say my favorite part about this game is the story, because then you finally have a sense of purpose, otherwise you spend hours grinding levels, looking for resources to build a gun that will suck once you progress to the next two planets. The game cleverly deceives you by making most loot easy to find, however it makes up for this by having you use a metric ton of resources to graft anything of real value. The game wants you to spend money to buy better equipment and characters, otherwise you're stuck spending hundreds of hours doing rifts, banking on pure chance that you'll find what you need. 

All on all, the game is a massive repetitive grind. The game will suddenly hit extreme difficulty spikes that punishes you for wanting to play by yourself. The combat is amazing and one of my favorite out of a video game. The story is good, but still remains unfinished after 8 years of development. It's hard for me to say that I do or don't recommend this game, because it has so much potential that seems to be going to waste right now. If you do pick up this game, you need to play with friends, it's 100 times better than playing with randoms 50 levels ahead of you just farming for loot. 

I give it a low 3/5 in its current state.
